description: Fork of exp355 (short-scale upper-graded out_tph). Bumps v_tph 128 -> 256 to test 'V is the weak link' hypothesis: V output is only 16-dim/head (vs d_qk=24), and the composite 64-dim V stream bounds what out_proj can extract. Doubles V per-pair redundancy from ~17 to ~34 votes/pair (CFC, d_v=16 -> 120 pairs). Extra cost: +0.4M V bits (negligible vs 235M out_proj).
